historical_evidence_note: Historical raw Engine Inspector outputs were recovered, but no executed layer-composition classifier was found. This transparent convention is frozen before inspecting current engines.

computational_layer_rule.description: A TensorRT layer is computational when ParameterType or LayerType identifies convolution, deconvolution, fully connected, or matrix multiplication. Reformat, shuffle, slice, resize, pooling, concatenation, pointwise-only, and copy layers are excluded from the computational denominator and retained in the non-computational count.

precision_rule.mixed_definition: More than one of INT8, FP16, or FP32 appears in the activation and weight evidence for a computational layer.
precision_rule.share_denominator: Total computational layers under the frozen computational_layer_rule.

detect_head_rule: Report all computational layers whose names contain /model.24/m or model.24.m, including their measured precision class.
interpretation_lock: Layer-count shares are composition shares, not execution-time shares.
